summary: It's not that the wicked burn too bright but we haunt that which is, but doesn't fit with 1000 flames. Until they give up. Burnt up. Used up. Just wanting a friend to come by the hotel room. #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
It's not that the wicked
  burn too bright
but we haunt that
which is, but
doesn't fit with
1000 flames.

Until they
give up.
Burnt up.
Used up.

Just wanting a friend to come by the hotel room.
#smallpoems
